title: Mouse embryonic stem cell-derived blood-brain barrier model: applicability to studying antibody triggered receptor mediated transcytosis.

compound_identity.salt: No salt specified; source identifies acid.
compound_identity.isomer_scope: Do not merge with retinol, 9-cis, 13-cis or unspecified RA.
compound_identity.identity_unit_conflict: All-trans identity is explicit; the initial-stage 10 mM versus 10 µM dose discrepancy remains.

schedule.model: Mouse ESC-D3 (ATCC), differentiated through mesoderm/endothelial-like stages; not a disease model.
schedule.induction: CHIR99021 is reported at 1.4 mM on the first day with BMP4/VEGF, followed by BMP4/VEGF continuation. Endothelial medium with bFGF/RA begins on prose day 6 for 2 days; replating is on day 8. The schematic labels these transitions day 5/day 7.
schedule.barrier_maturation: Collagen IV/fibronectin transwells; RA 10 µM and bFGF 5 ng/mL. Abluminal ACM:EM 1:1 contains Y-27632 10 µM, hydrocortisone 1.4 µM and RA. Endothelial medium is changed daily.
schedule.assessment: TEER followed for 11 days after plating; optimized functional assays usually 5–10 days after plating, with TEER 300–600 Ωcm².
schedule.control: Direct +/-RA cultures; no matched RA-solvent control reported. Other media components, growth factors and ACM remain part of the culture context.

functional_evidence.comparison: mBEC differentiation with versus without RA, in supportive culture with ACM; not a damaged-barrier repair test.
functional_evidence.positive: Author gives 141 Ωcm² at 72 hours and 350–400 by day 7, about 350 on day 11 with RA; without RA only 60–100 over 11 days. Native Fig3A agrees directionally.
functional_evidence.replication: Representative of 3 independent differentiations; mean±SD. Global Methods says at least 3 technical experiments unless specified.
functional_evidence.statistics: No panel-specific P value, significance bracket or test supplied in Fig3A; effect size/direction retained without inventing significance.

functional_evidence.comparison: Optimized multicomponent mBEC model versus other cell models; not a clean RA-only contrast.
functional_evidence.positive: NaFl Pe: 1.7e-5 cm/min for mBEC, 2.0e-5 for iBEC, 1.02e-3 for bEnd.3, and 0.44e-3 for SV-ARBEC. Native Fig3E and S5 support low paracellular leakage.
functional_evidence.replication: Fig3D/E represent 6 independent differentiations; S5 represents 3.
functional_evidence.limit: Different lineages, coatings, media and maturation durations; do not assign the entire model difference to RA.

functional_evidence.positive: A–B 0.68±0.04e-3 and B–A 1.31±0.06e-3 cm/min; efflux ratio 1.94.
functional_evidence.limit: Authors note a ratio below 2 and that Rhodamine is also an OATP1A2/OCT1 substrate; no P-gp-specific inhibitor arm. Polarized transport retained; exclusive P-gp attribution unconfirmed.

functional_evidence.positive: The model distinguishes mouse-selective 8D3 from the human model and high/low TfR affinity variants; cross-reactive FC5-Fc/IGF1R5-Fc transport retained. Holo-Tf increases high-affinity 8D3 transport directionally.
functional_evidence.nulls: 8D3 variants are negligible in the human model; J05-Fc transport is not significantly changed with holo-Tf per authors.
functional_evidence.replication: Fig5/6 are from 2 independent differentiations; antibodies 1.25 µM and holo-Tf 2 mg/mL where indicated.
functional_evidence.controls: A20.1 anti-C. difficile toxin A negative antibody; empty-insert background; mouse/human comparators.
functional_evidence.limit: No RA-treated versus untreated transport comparison. Highest 8D3 values extend above the drawn ULOQ line, qualifying exact magnitudes. Panel-specific tests/P values are not provided.

marker_and_lineage.positive: Day 8 flow: GLUT1 100%, CD31 77%, VE-cadherin 79.4%, claudin 5 82.3%; five independent differentiations represented. RA-positive S4 has larger displayed median fluorescence for six BBB/endothelial markers (two independent differentiations; no statistical tests reported).
marker_and_lineage.purity_limit: Flk1-positive progenitors at 97.3% and matrix selection do not prove pure mature brain endothelium. Authors acknowledge a mixed endothelial/epithelial phenotype; native S7 shows epithelial/choroid-plexus markers.
marker_and_lineage.functional_limit: Matrigel tube formation is not specific to endothelium; authors suggest a more stringent fibrin-bead assay.
marker_and_lineage.cell_proliferation_survival: Growth/proliferative RNA context is reported; no RA-specific survival, clonal proliferation, apoptosis or injury-recovery endpoint.
marker_and_lineage.generalization: One mESC-D3 line and one HAF-iPSC comparator; independent differentiations are not independent donors/genotypes.

BUB1B_context.native_location: Main Table 2, publisher PDF page 16; cell-cycle column under Pathways up.
BUB1B_context.contrast: mESC-D3-derived mBECs versus primary mouse BECs (pmBECs), not RA-positive versus RA-negative cultures.
BUB1B_context.assay: RNAseq, STAR alignment to GRCm39/GencodeM26; DESeq2 normalization; average of 3 replicates; heatmaps use log2-transformed normalized read counts.
BUB1B_context.pathway_method: GSEA v4.0.3, C2 Canonical Pathways, 1000 permutations; table footnote summarizes significantly changed pathways.
BUB1B_context.interpretation: BUB1B appears in the listed upregulated cell-cycle gene-set context. No individual quantitative BUB1B row or RA-specific attribution is supplied.
BUB1B_context.BUBR1protein_stability_function: Not measured; no specific BUBR1 antibody or BUB1B RT-PCR primer appears in supplementary Tables S2/S3.
BUB1B_context.data_limit: Data availability offers data upon request; no public RNA accession identified, and no data requested or reanalyzed.
